# prismasdwan_element_bgp_config (Resource)

Manages a Prisma SD-WAN Element Bgp Config.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Palo Alto Networks Inc. 2025
#
# Sample resource example for "element_bgp_config".
# This file is generated - do not edit by hand.
#
# Before using this example, configure the Prisma SD-WAN provider:
#
#   terraform {
#     required_providers {
#       prismasdwan = {
#         source  = "paloaltonetworks/prismasdwan"
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
#   provider "prismasdwan" {
#     host          = "api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com"
#     client_id     = "acmeuser@12345.iam.panserviceaccount.com"
#     client_secret = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
#     scope         = "tsg_id:12345"
#     auth_url      = "https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token"
#   }

resource "prismasdwan_element_bgp_config" "example" {
  admin_distance              = 1
  adv_interval                = 30
  graceful_restart            = false
  hold_time                   = 30
  ipv6_prefixes_to_adv_to_wan = ["2001:db8::1"]
  keepalive_time              = 30
  local_as_num                = "65000"
  maximum_paths               = 10
  md5_secret                  = "<secret>"
  multi_hop_limit             = 3
  ospf_redistribution = [{
    route_map_id   = "<route_map_id>"
    vrf_context_id = "<vrf_context_id>"
  }]
  peer_auth_type         = "md5"
  peer_retry_time        = 30
  prefix_adv_type        = "example_prefix_adv_type"
  prefix_adv_type_to_lan = "example_prefix_adv_type_to_lan"
  prefixes_to_adv_to_wan = ["example_prefixes_to_adv_to_wan"]
  router_id              = "<router_id>"
  stalepath_time         = 30
  vrf_router_id_map = [{
    router_id      = "<router_id>"
    vrf_context_id = "<vrf_context_id>"
  }]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_distance` (Number) Admin distance. Value: between 1 and 255.
- `adv_interval` (Number) Adv interval. Value: between 0 and 600.
- `graceful_restart` (Boolean) Graceful restart.
- `hold_time` (Number) Hold time. Value: between 3 and 600.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object, assigned by the API. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `ipv6_prefixes_to_adv_to_wan` (List of String) Ipv6 prefixes to adv to wan.
- `keepalive_time` (Number) Keepalive time. Value: between 1 and 200.
- `local_as_num` (String) Local as num. Value: at most 256 characters.
- `maximum_paths` (Number) Maximum paths. Value: between 1 and 255.
- `md5_secret` (String, Sensitive) Md5 secret. Value: at most 32 characters.
- `md5_secret_internal_key_name` (String) Internal key name for the sensitive attribute md5_secret, managed automatically by the provider.
- `multi_hop_limit` (Number) Multi hop limit. Value: between 1 and 255.
- `ospf_redistribution` (Attributes List) Ospf redistribution. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ospf_redistribution))
- `peer_auth_type` (String) Peer auth type. Value: one of md5, none.
- `peer_retry_time` (Number) Peer retry time. Value: between 1 and 65535.
- `prefix_adv_type` (String) Prefix adv type.
- `prefix_adv_type_to_lan` (String) Prefix adv type to lan.
- `prefixes_to_adv_to_wan` (List of String) Prefixes to adv to wan.
- `router_id` (String) Router id. Value: at most 256 characters.
- `stalepath_time` (Number) Stalepath time. Value: between 1 and 3600.
- `vrf_router_id_map` (Attributes List) Vrf router id map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrf_router_id_map))
- `x_etag` (Number) Etag for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `x_parameters` (Map of String) Path parameters for the resource, managed automatically by the provider.
- `x_schema` (Number) Schema version for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
